material_findings.title: CoinMarketCap API Hackathon is live through Sep. 30 with an AI Agents and Automation track
material_findings.summary: CoinMarketCap's organizer-primary page defines a virtual worldwide hackathon running Sep. 9-30, 2026 for entrants age 18+, solo or teams up to four. Its four tracks include AI Agents and Automation, Markets and Trading Tools, Data and Visualisation, and Real World Assets. Submissions require a public repository, working demo or recording, an X post, explicit CMC API endpoints and visible real API-call evidence. The headline $10K prize value is not cash: the top three receive one-year CMC Pro API-plan grants, the top 30 receive swag, and all registered participants receive Startup-tier API access during the event; prizes cannot be exchanged for cash. Pre-existing projects are allowed only when the CMC integration is new and clearly identified, and AI coding assistants/open-source dependencies are allowed.
material_findings.recommended_action: When chronology reaches this contribution, reopen the organizer and DoraHacks surfaces, verify participant registration and any rule revisions, and evaluate a narrow agent/research-tool build using CMC data only if participation is intended. Preserve API-key handling and never commit keys. If this lane proves recurring, review CoinMarketCap deliberately for addition to the canonical source registry rather than creating a parallel source list.
